decision: Do not integrate the V19 developer pack. The exact Swift runtime fails closed on 71 of 400 public segments because neither local parent preserves the current critical-token contract.
interpretation: The earlier stored-output composition modeled only empty and repeated-token fallback. The real runtime also enforces critical-token and plausibility guards, so its 320/9/71 routing supersedes the stored 398/2 routing for integration decisions.
The pinned COMET result remains reproducible for the stored composition, but it is not an app-path quality result and cannot authorize promotion.
The 12-case app-path canary passes after a narrow calendar-month equivalence fix with wrong-month negative controls, but that fix does not cover general bilingual numeric transformations.
The repository's typed bilingual numeric policy remains an offline ablation and has unsafe reference disagreements; it is not promoted into the runtime.

Adding the available critical-specialist Marian pair does not solve the dominant failures because many are genuine number, article, score, or coordinate mistranslations shared across the compact parents.
next_strategy: Train or select a stronger number- and legal-structure-preserving fallback, or implement source-normalized constrained numeric decoding with adversarial and held-out validation. Do not broadly relax the runtime guard.
